(1) Apollo Hospitals' own site publishes two dedicated pages for her, one under /region/hyderabad/doctor/ and one under the obstetrician-and-gynecologist Hyderabad specialty index, and states her practice location as Apollo Health City, Jubilee Hills - matching the input row's hospital AND address exactly. (2) healinindia.gov.in, the Government of India Advantage Healthcare directory (a .gov.in domain, so independent and official), carries her with the title 'Obstetrics & Gynecology in Apollo Hospitals Hyderabad'. Name (distinctive Odia surname 'Rath', no same-name collision surfaced anywhere in Hyderabad O&G), specialty, hospital, branch and city therefore all match - four of the section-2 criteria, well past the required two. NO SAME-NAME AMBIGUITY: every result across three searches resolved to one Apollo Hyderabad gynaecologist. NO FORMER-EMPLOYER-ELSEWHERE pattern found: unlike the stale-affiliation rows, no other hospital group publishes a competing current profile for her; all her listed locations are Apollo-group (Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills, Apollo Cradle Jubilee Hills, Apollo Cradle Kondapur) plus AJ's Woman & Child Clinic in Kondapur. CONTACTS DELIBERATELY DISCARDED - all summary-asserted, none institutional: the search summary offered '8919868226' and '8186807795' as direct contact numbers. Both are 10-digit Indian MOBILE-series numbers (8xxxxxxxxx) and her own site's booking button routes to WhatsApp, so these are personal mobile/WhatsApp lines - rejected outright under the section-4 rule on mobile series, no institutional line was published anywhere. Also rejected: '1-860-500-4424' (a central Apollo/Apollo Cradle booking line, not hers - the section-4 rule forbids recording a hospital's central booking line as a doctor's own) and 'hello@hexahealth.com' / '6366530173' (HexaHealth aggregator helpline, reaches the aggregator not the doctor).
